CVE-2007-2027.title: Untrusted search path vulnerability in the add_filename_to_string ...
CVE-2007-2027.description: Untrusted search path vulnerability in the add_filename_to_string function in intl/gettext/loadmsgcat.c for Elinks 0.11.1 allows local users to cause Elinks to use an untrusted gettext message catalog (.po file) in a "../po" directory, which can be leveraged to conduct format string attacks.

CVE-2007-5034.title: ELinks before 0.11.3, when sending a POST request for an https UR ...
CVE-2007-5034.description: ELinks before 0.11.3, when sending a POST request for an https URL, appends the body and content headers of the POST request to the CONNECT request in cleartext, which allows remote attackers to sniff sensitive data that would have been protected by TLS.  NOTE: this issue only occurs when a proxy is defined for https.
